about_the_game:
Composed by Tyler Mire over 7 years, the Quartet soundtrack is comprised of 94 diverse tracks reflecting the vast and colorful game world of Quartet! Joined by over 20+ musicians, the soundtrack is eclectic, melodic and emotionally powerful!

Musician Credits:

Tyler Mire - Composer, Producer, Trumpet, Whistler, Toy Shaker, Vocals

Livingston Rampey - Composer of "The Wanderer", string programming "Conflagration", Flute EQ on "The Birthplace of Magic"

Woodwinds:

Brett McDonald - Soprano Sax, Alto Sax, Tenor Sax, Bari Sax, Bass Clarinet, Clarinet, Flute, Alto Flute, Bass Flute, Recorder

Kelsey Mire - Bari Sax, Bass Saxophone, Bass Clarinet, Clarinet, Bassoon

Paul White - Alto Sax, Tenor Sax, Bari Sax

Carlos Mata - Alto Sax, Tenor Sax, Bari Sax

Aaron Hedenstrom - Alto Sax

Jeff Coffin - Flute

Emily Bowland - Clarinet

Kristin Naigus - English Horn

Diana Dunn - English Horn, Oboe

Brass:
